age.evidence: Males and females (8-12-week-old) were housed in a light- and temperature-controlled room throughout the experimental procedures

sex.evidence: we used male and female, 5-HT 2A R knockout (KO) and wild type (WT) mice injected with a single noribo dose (10 or 40 mg/kg; i.p.)

dosing.evidence: Then, they were administered a single intraperitoneal injection of the corresponding treatment: vehicle (saline solution), noribogaine 10 mg/kg, or 40 mg/kg.

group_housing.evidence: Males and females (8-12-week-old) were housed in a light- and temperature-controlled room (cage density not stated)

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12 h light/dark cycle (lights on at 8:00 a.m.)... Behavioral recordings were made... from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. of the light period of the photocycle

assays.assay_description: Custom open-field plastic compartment (19 cm x 40 cm x 40 cm) in a sound-attenuated room, video-tracked with EthoVision XT. 15 min pre-injection baseline recording, then i.p. vehicle or noribogaine (10 or 40 mg/kg) and 30 min post-injection recording; total distance traveled (cm). Male and female 5-HT2A KO and WT mice.

application_type.evidence: they were administered a single intraperitoneal injection of the corresponding treatment: vehicle (saline solution), noribogaine 10 mg/kg, or 40 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes for 15 min (recorded as baseline) and later injected with drugs or saline. The 15-min 'habituation' period was recorded and analysed, so it is a baseline session, not a separate no-data habituation exposure.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice locomotor activity (total distance, in cm) was recorded using a CCD camera on custom-designed open-field boxes

food_restriction.evidence: Each box consisted of an open-field plastic compartment (19 cm × 40 cm × 40 cm); no food in the apparatus (home cage: food ad libitum)

water_restriction.evidence: Each box consisted of an open-field plastic compartment (19 cm × 40 cm × 40 cm); no water in the apparatus (home cage: water ad libitum)

time_to_assay.evidence: Total distance traveled (in cm) was quantified for a total of 30 min after injections. The paper also states 'we measured locomotor activity thirty minutes after a single noribo administration', but the Methods and Figure 1 describe recording starting immediately post-injection.

sample_size.evidence: For male mice... N = 9-12... Female mice injected with noribo... N = 7-11

outcomes.summary: Noribogaine 40 mg/kg decreased total distance traveled in WT male mice and in KO female mice, but not in WT females. Noribogaine 10 mg/kg had no significant effect in either sex. Baseline locomotion differed by sex but not genotype.
outcomes.statistics: Habituation: sex F(1,120)=21.11, p<0.0001; genotype F(1,120)=2.72, p>0.05; interaction F(1,120)=0.90, p>0.05. Males: treatment F(2,57)=8.7, p<0.001; genotype F(1,57)=0.52, p>0.05; interaction F(2,57)=1.5, p>0.05; WT Noribo 40 vs vehicle Tukey p<0.05. Females: treatment F(2,52)=6.42, p<0.001; genotype F(1,52)=0.01, p>0.05; interaction F(2,52)=1.74, p>0.05; KO Noribo 40 vs vehicle KO Tukey p<0.05.
outcomes.evidence: As shown in Figure 2A, WT male mice injected with Noribo 40 showed decreased locomotion, compared to the vehicle (Tukey post-hoc; p < 0.05)... female KO mice injected with Noribo 40 showed less locomotion compared to vehicle KO (Tukey post-hoc; p < 0.05).

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (open-field locomotion). qPCR and slice patch-clamp electrophysiology were excluded as non-behavioural.

setup_habituation overridden from the modal 'yes' to 'not_reported'. The 15-min 'habituation' was recorded and analysed as baseline. The rubric excludes data-collecting exposures from setup habituation, and no separate pre-test apparatus exposure is described.

time_to_assay: candidates used 30 min based on the Results phrase 'thirty minutes after'. The Methods and Figure 1 state recording covered the 30 min immediately after injection, so value_minutes was set to 0 (bin unchanged: acute_0to2h).
Direction set to 'decrease' (2 of 3 candidates). All significant effects were reductions in locomotion; the subgroup differences are captured by sex_dependent rather than labelled 'mixed'.
n_total left null. The paper gives only per-group ranges (males N=9-12, females N=7-11); n_per_group_min = 7.
Age set to young_adult (modal) for the 8-12-week behavioural cohort. The 4-8-week mice were used only for electrophysiology, which is not scored.
Environmental items not explicitly addressed for the plastic open-field compartment (bedding, nesting, objects, food/water) were scored 0 with medium confidence.
